[[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] of the [[One Sith]] order maintained a '''library''' of ancient books of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] lore within the [[Temple of the Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==The collection==
Darth Wyyrlok's collection of Sith books comprised a variety of titles in Aurebesh including ''[[From the Darkest Heart]]''. Also present were some books whose titles (partially obscured) read:

*[[From the Darkest Way of the Force|''From the Darkest Way of the Force: Lo[...]formities'']]
*[[Life (book)|''Life After Depart[...]'']]
*[[Darth-Nemo-Dak|''Darth-Nemo-Dak Discov[...]'']]
*[[Jaure Tche|''A- Jaure Tche Manual D[...] Z[...]'']]
*[[Unidentified Sith book|''Mimi-Ika - Rgki[...]rri'']]
*[[Komo'rompo']]
*[[Lag -Sick Life -Etkalcha, Dreams]]

At least one volume was titled in an [[Unidentified alphabet/Legends|unidentified Tatooinian alphabet]]: [[Unidentified Sith book (Krayt Dragon)|''Kray[...] Dra[...]'']].<ref name="Legacy 27" />

{{IncompleteList}}

==History==
In [[137 ABY]], Darth Wyyrlok searched through his collection in order to find a cure for a [[Death/Legends|terminal]] affliction suffered by his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="Legacy 27" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Wyyrlok's library appeared a flashback in the [[Legacy (2006) 27|twenty-seventh issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' from publisher [[Dark Horse Comics]].<ref name="Legacy 27" /> The issue was published on [[August 27]], [[2008]]<ref name="Release Date">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/15-530/Star-Wars-Legacy-27|text=Star Wars: Legacy #27}}</ref> and was written by [[John Ostrander]] with illustrations by [[Omar Francia]] and [[Brad Anderson]]. In the comic, Wyyrlock is depicted paging through a large tome while dozens of other books with various titles surround him.<ref name="Legacy 27" />
